nodes.text: Swale. Stores. Say what you need and watch me have it.

choices.text: What sells in a place like this?

nodes.text: Rope, tar, biscuit. Line, hook, lamp oil. Boots, salt, nerve. Everything the water asks for, it asks for in threes.
Carters say the Gullmoor lamp still burns and the moor past it has teeth. Wolves, and worse than wolves. Buy arrows. Buy the tincture. Buy twice.
Come back caught short. They always do.
